# Tracks, Siege Maps and Extended Cuts — reference

*Generated by `tools/build_reference.js` from the ten files in `scripts/expanded/`. Do not edit by hand: change the script and rebuild. The same content is in `data/tracks.json`, `data/siege_maps.json` and `data/climax_extended.json`.*

The rules for all three are in `docs/expanded/BETA_06_DESIGN_DOCUMENT_EXPANDED.md` (tracks §X3, the Siege Map §X4.1, the Extended Cut §X5). This file puts every region's tables side by side, so they can be compared and tuned together.

## 1. World-state tracks

### Roaming and Cipher (the finale) — *The Stock* (`cipher.x.stock`)

| Step | Name | Gained when | Effect at the Finale |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | **Samples** | Any liaison leaves a region unbeaten | +1 Admin duel in Phase 3 |
| 2 | **Shipments** | Any region's Apex Shadow enters the Region of Doom | That Apex stands guard in Phase 4 |
| 3 | **Three Beasts** | Raikou, Entei and Suicune were all shipped from Johto | The three liaisons who hold them return together |
| 4 | **The Reading** | `cipher.lugia-reading` is set (Johto Raid 5 Failed or Declined) | XD001 has one extra lock |
| 5 | **Complete** | Five or more regions were lost or stayed out of | The Finale's timer is 2 turns shorter |

### Kanto — *The Ledger Fills* (`rocket.x.ledger`)

| Step | Name | Regional rule | Civilian mood |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | **Small Print** | One shop per city charges +10% ("insurance") | Nervous |
| 2 | **House Rules** | Game Corner prizes are Black-Label; one Pokémon Center per city closes at night | Careful |
| 3 | **Closed Roads** | Two routes are blocked by a Snorlax; detour nodes appear | Angry |
| 4 | **Export** | Wild encounter pools near Vermilion shrink by a quarter (poached) | Frightened |
| 5 | **Under New Management** | Saffron's gates are shut before the climax; the news runs Rocket adverts | Silent |

| Step | Name | Regional rule | Civilian mood |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | **Static** | Radios in rest nodes play static; the Pokégear map loses one node of preview | Puzzled |
| 2 | **Jingle** | Shops play the Rocket jingle; Slowpoke tails appear in one shop per city | Uneasy |
| 3 | **Rage** | Wild Pokémon near water are one evolution stage higher at 20% odds | Frightened |
| 4 | **Carrier Wave** | The signal reaches the next region's border; one Kanto-style Black-Label Pokémon appears on Executive teams | Tired |
| 5 | **The Call** | Every radio carries Archer's voice; the climax is scheduled | Listening |

| --- | --- | --- | --- |

| 3 | **The Swing** | Weather flips every two turns in wild battles | Exhausted |
| 4 | **Spill** | Berry trees fail on one side of the region; ferries or cable cars stop, by tilt | Leaving |

| Step | Name | Regional rule | Civilian mood |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |

| 3a | **Lake Acuity taken (Uxie)** | *Memory:* the map shows one fewer node ahead | Forgetful |
| 3b | **Lake Verity taken (Mesprit)** | *Feeling:* friendship and bond gains are halved | Flat |

| 3 | **The Frost Line** | The northern third of the map is under snow: ice hazards, Ice moves +10% for both sides | Cold |

## 2. Siege Maps (Phase 0b)

### Roaming and Cipher (the finale) — The Alliance

| Approach | Held if any of these is true | If Lost |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **The Whirlpool Gate (sea)** | Hoenn's titans both rest; or Johto's young Lugia went home; or Chobin is free | The Crossing has three battles, not two |
| **The Lava Flats** | Paldea's Engine was pulled apart (five Starmobiles arrive, honking); or Kanto's Blaine walked with the player | Lava hazard in Phase 2 (1/16 HP every third turn to non-Fire Pokémon) |
| **The Sky Lift** | Any one of: Lance (Johto), N with a dragon (Unova), Leon (Galar) | Phase 2 has one more wave |
| **The Cliff Stair** | Any one of: Cynthia or Looker (Sinnoh), Nanu (Alola), Diantha (Kalos) | The Breather heals 35% |
| **The Dome** | Never | See Phase 4 |
